seo.title: Photo Credits
seo.description: Credits and licences for the photographs used on the {{name}} website.

lead: The {{photoCount}} photographs on this site that we didn't take ourselves, who took them, and the licence each one is used under.
intro: Photos marked CC BY or CC BY-SA are used under Creative Commons licences that ask for this credit. Unsplash and Pexels photos are free to use without credit; they're listed anyway. Every photo is resized and recompressed for the web; any other change is noted. Captions describe the kind of work shown, not whose crew is in the picture.
